description: Error kinds, messages and lines. Messages use MoonSharp's 'chunk:(line,from-to): text' position; Lua 5.2 writes 'chunk:line:' and names the variable.

  error('deep', 2)
end

cases.name: pcall returns false and the message
pcall around a function that calls a metamethod
cases.source:
local o = setmetatable({}, { __tostring = function() return 'obj' end })
return { pcall(tostring, o) }

cases.name: pcall of a table error gets a string
cases.source: local ok, e = pcall(error, { c = 1 }) return { ok, type(e), e }
expect: bad argument #1 to 'error' (string expected, got table)

cases.name: pcall keeps the position in the message
cases.source: local ok, e = pcall(function() local a = nil; return a.b end) return e

cases.name: xpcall calls the handler
